name: Amanda's Magic Book 11: Fractured Reflections
storyline:
A new mystery takes root in the historic heart of Florence. When Amanda and Charlie stumble upon an ancient, cursed mirror tucked away in a forgotten villa, their reality is turned upside down - literally. The mirror shatters, splintering the world into kaleidoscopic dimensions filled with eerie doubles, crumbling illusions, and haunting echoes of themselves.

Guided by Liora, an enigmatic figure who may or may not be part of the mirror's secret, Amanda and Charlie must navigate this fractured dimension. The Aeternum Mirror holds immense power, but its shattering has thrown the balance between realities into chaos. With time running out and the boundary between real and unreal disintegrating, only solving mind-bending puzzles and restoring the mirror's fragments can save them - and possibly the world itself.
summary: Enter a realm where mirrors distort reality. Explore a distorted Florence, where every reflection hides secrets. Uncover the lost power of the Aeternum Mirror and mend its broken shards. Face mirror-clone versions of yourself and decipher who's truly real.
